hero.sub: Every problem from the videos — typed up, worked through, and waiting for you to try it first. No lectures. No textbooks. Just good problems.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Mira.
about.shortParagraph: I started posting problems from my old notebooks during exam season, mostly to keep myself sane. Three years later, this is somehow a full-time thing.
paragraphs: I started posting problems from my old notebooks during exam season, mostly to keep myself sane. Three years later, this is somehow a full-time thing.

I still solve every problem by hand before it goes anywhere near a script. If the working does not fit on one index card, it usually means I have not understood it well enough yet — so it goes back in the pile.
The videos are short because the good part of a problem is short. Everything around it — the setup, the false starts, the algebra — lives here instead, so you can try it yourself before I say a word.

newsletter.heading: Get tomorrow's problem tonight, before it hits the feed.
newsletter.note: One problem a day. No digests, no course upsells.
